issues.title: The Lady Luck reel overlay is covered by the guide card, so reel 1 and the DUD warning are half hidden
issues.expected: The reel overlay is readable while the player stops each reel; slot 1 decides the Cherry tier.
issues.observed: Reported by the lady-luck lane: the guide card is drawn above the overlay at top-left. Not re-reproduced in this review (no Lady Luck fight was driven).
issues.repro: Chapter V with Lady Luck, open Attack Reels with the guide card shown (lane evidence docs/handoff/r37-lady-luck.md).
issues.where: src/ui/ffx2 guide card z-order vs LadyLuckReels (suspected)
issues.fix: Raise the overlay above the guide or hide the guide while a minigame is open.
issues.acceptanceCheck: Open Attack Reels with the guide up; all three reels and the DUD line are fully visible.

issues.title: Trigger Happy now honours a human's press count, so a Gunner who mashes under about 14 times does less than on live
issues.expected: research/ffx2-combat-core.md line 262: Trigger Happy is "one hit per R1 press"; the rule is faithful.
issues.observed: On release 36 any press count resolved as the engine roll (14 hits); on the candidate it resolves as the presses (3 gives 3). Not re-run in a browser by this review; read from the lane's CONTRACT-CHANGES entry and minigames.ts.
issues.repro: Chapter IV or V, Gunner, Trigger Happy, press 3 times in the window.
issues.requirement: Faithful mechanic (sourced); disclose the balance effect
issues.fix: None needed; tell Bailey. Optionally make the window or the prompt say "press as fast as you can".
issues.acceptanceCheck: The onboarding copy for the Gunner names the press count.

issues.title: FFX-2 Chapter IV first-run coach is clipped at the right edge at 2000x1012 for some first actors and covers the enemy intent card
issues.expected: The first-run coach sits fully on screen without hiding the enemy intent card.
issues.observed: Seed 2 at 2000x1012: the coach tag reaches x=2046 on a 2000 px page ("HOLDS TH" cut), and the card covers "92% to hit" and "HOLD +1 MORE" of the intent card. Live places the coach bottom-left for the same seed. Seeds 1 to 6 at 1600x900 are all on screen. On live, other seeds put the coach over the intent card at bottom-left, so the overlap is old; the clip is new.
issues.repro: Fresh profile, seed 2, 2000x1012, Chapter IV, first menu (Yuna, White Magic): coach right edge 2046 against 2000. coach-probe-cand/seed2.png vs coach-probe-live/seed2.png.
issues.where: src/ui/coach/CoachLayer.ts placement (suspected; the ui-floor lane describes the same clip and is not merged)
issues.fix: Clamp the coach card and its tag to the viewport width; avoid the intent card rectangle.
issues.acceptanceCheck: Seeds 1 to 8 at 1600x900 and 2000x1012: every coach rect inside the viewport.

issues.title: On a phone the Chapter IV first-run coach covers the enemy intent card
issues.expected: The intent card stays readable on the first turn.
issues.observed: At 390x844 the coach card sits over the second line of "BAHAMUT ACTS NEXT" on both live and the candidate.
issues.fix: Place the phone coach below the intent card.
issues.acceptanceCheck: Intent card fully visible with the coach up at 390x844.

issues.title: Living portrait: dark or pale iris edge on Yuna X-2 (and Wakka)
issues.expected: The animated eyes match the painted plate.
issues.observed: At 390x844 the blue iris of Yuna X-2 shows a darker rim and the green iris a small halo against the static live plate. Disclosed by the portraits-live checker. The parts are Bailey's D-320 picks, so a re-pick is his.
issues.fix: Re-pick the eye window or feather its edge.

issues.title: One Chapter IV run: the active girl changed between reading the menu and confirming, so Attack opened White Magic instead
issues.expected: The command menu stays with the girl it was shown for.
issues.observed: In the first two desktop runs (1600x900 and 2000x1012, no seed) the rows read as Attack, Skill, Change, Item; the four Enters then opened Yuna's White Magic and Cure (screenshot 08) and the log did not grow. Three later runs with the same script passed, a probe showed that P, E and Esc do not change the actor, and the first actor differs by seed. Cause unproven; likely the harness reading the menu while the next girl took over.
issues.fix: Repeat with a seed sweep on the deep review.
issues.acceptanceCheck: Twenty seeded Ch IV first turns: the menu actor never changes without input.
